name: Perplexity
tagline: AI search that always answers with a source
description: AI search engine that delivers answers with source links, model selection and deep research for anyone who needs to verify facts before deciding.
priceNote: Pricing as of October 2026; plans change — check the official site.
bestFor: Anyone who needs an answer with a source, not an opinion
pros: Every answer comes with a source link, so you can check it and reuse it in professional material
You can pick different models for the same question, which is useful for comparing answer quality
Deep research mode delivers a structured report with references in minutes
Light and fast interface, which the team adopts without any training
cons: Cited sources sometimes have questionable quality, and the model can trust weak content
It does not automate processes or integrate with systems: it is a research and writing tool
Long, creative writing still lags behind ChatGPT and Claude in our evaluations
The monthly limit on advanced queries runs out in the middle of an important analysis

features.name: Workspaces

useCases: Collect competitor pricing and replenishment times with source links for the sales meeting
Check the current version of a technical standard before drafting an internal document
Research market objections before launching a new service
Review client performance by cross-checking updated public data
bestForWho: Sales, marketing and content teams that need decisions backed by verifiable data, fast.
verdict: Perplexity is the best research tool we have used, and the difference shows exactly in the source link, which lets you verify before taking any information to a client. The problem is source quality: the system cites what it found, including blogs with no credentials, and the text sometimes inherits the weakness of the source. It also does not replace a long-form writing assistant and does not integrate with any system. For a small company, the Pro plan at twenty dollars pays off for the sales and content team, because research turns into decisions faster. For a larger company, the Enterprise Pro plan is the way, with usage controls and per-user billing, and check the advanced query limit before you run an entire market analysis in a single day.
